lrc.lyric:
[00:00.300]Amazing grace, how sweet the sound
[00:11.000]That saved a wretch like me
[00:23.000]I once was lost but now I'm found
[00:34.000]Was blind, but now, I see
[00:45.000]T'was grace that taught
[00:50.000]My heart to fear
[00:56.000]And grace, my fears relieved
[01:07.000]How precious did that grace appear
[01:18.000]The hour I first believed
[01:30.000]Through many dangers, toils and snares
[01:40.000]We have already come
[01:52.000]T'was grace that brought us safe thus far
[02:02.000]And grace will lead us home
[02:13.998]When we've been there ten thousand years bright shining as the sun
[02:37.998]We‘ve no less days to sing god's praise than when we first begun
[02:54.998]Amazing grace, how sweet the sound
[03:06.998]That saved a wretch like me
[03:18.998]I once was lost but now I'm found
[03:30.998]Was blind, but now, I see

tlyric.lyric:
[00:00.300]天赐恩典，如此甘甜
[00:11.000]我罪已得赦免
[00:23.000]前我失丧，今被寻回
[00:34.000]盲眼今又得重见
[00:45.000]神之恩典
[00:50.000]教我敬畏
[00:56.000]使我心灵更释然
[01:07.000]归信伊始，即蒙恩惠
[01:18.000]如何能够不称颂
[01:30.000]历尽艰险，饱受磨难
[01:40.000]我已安然得经过
[01:52.000]蒙此恩典，赐我平安
[02:02.000]其恩惠引我归居
[02:13.998]人生在世，已逾万年；光芒何等耀眼
[02:37.998]齐聚吟颂，神之恩典；从今万世永流传
[02:54.998]天赐恩典，如此甘甜
[03:06.998]我罪竟已得赦免
[03:18.998]我曾迷途，而今知返
[03:30.998]盲眼今又得重见
